Container.Name: TautWeekly for Plex
Container.Overview: Generate preview-first weekly Plex activity newsletters using Tautulli. The WebUI link opens a read-only preview viewer, not an admin panel. After installation, open the container Console and run: /opt/tautweekly/bin/run-script.sh Setup-First.ps1. This launcher uses the configured non-root PUID/PGID and repairs legacy root-owned appdata entries. Unraid checks the configured stable latest image and applies updates from its Docker/Apps controls.
Container.Description: TautWeekly for Plex generates activity, welcome, quiet-week, and milestone email newsletters. Configuration and generated output stay in appdata. Scheduling is disabled by default. Complete setup from the Console, then review browser previews and TestEmail delivery before enabling production sends. No in-container updater, Docker socket, or edge image is enabled.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Tautulli Plex newsletter email activity digest
Container.Requires: A reachable Tautulli server, an SMTP STARTTLS account, and a trusted LAN port for browser previews.
Container.Changes: 2026-08-13: Routed Console setup and management through the configured non-root PUID/PGID and added safe recovery for legacy root-owned appdata entries. 2026-08-07: Clarified that Unraid owns stable image checks and update application; no in-container updater or edge channel is enabled. 2026-08-05: Added a first-run preview landing page, explicit setup guidance, and clearer preview-server failure reporting. 2026-08-04: Initial Community Apps template.

Config.Name: Preview Viewer
Config.Description: Trusted-LAN HTTP port for the read-only landing page and generated previews. This is not an admin UI. Do not expose it publicly.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Private configuration, state, logs, assets, and generated previews.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used by the weekly scheduler, for example America/Phoenix.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Non-root Unraid user ID used for appdata ownership.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Non-root Unraid group ID used for appdata ownership.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Restrictive file-creation mask for configuration and output.

Config.Name: Preview Base URL
Config.Description: Optional LAN URL embedded in preview links, for example http://tower:8787. Never use a public URL.
